themes_detail.label: Dead Animal Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Dead animal complaints have spiked to 10 THIS WEEK, a 627% increase vs. the 1.4-complaint weekly average over the prior 8 weeks (z-score: 7.08), suggesting a sudden public health and sanitation emergency in Morris Park/Pelham Parkway.
evidence: 10 dead animal complaints THIS WEEK vs. 1.4 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (627% spike)
Z-score of 7.08 indicates statistically severe outlier event
No prior Reddit or media mentions suggest this is a new, acute problem
reporting_angles: Interview DSNY about whether there is a specific source (poisoning, disease outbreak, infrastructure failure) driving the spike
Canvass residents in neighborhoods with highest concentration of complaints to document health concerns and timeline

themes_detail.label: Hazardous Tree Overgrowth
themes_detail.summary: Overgrown tree and branch complaints spiked to 9 LAST WEEK, a 554% increase vs. the 1.4-complaint weekly average over the prior 8 weeks (z-score: 6.26), indicating potential safety hazards and lack of Parks Department maintenance.
evidence: 9 overgrown tree/branch complaints last week vs. 1.4 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (554% spike)
Spike coincides with late spring tree growth season; timing suggests either deferred maintenance or rapid seasonal growth
reporting_angles: Obtain Parks Department maintenance records for CD211 to determine if pruning schedules have been delayed or cut
Document specific locations with safety risks (blocked sightlines, hazards to pedestrians/vehicles) and photograph conditions

themes_detail.label: Building Code Violations Surge
themes_detail.summary: Building/Use complaints jumped to 15 THIS WEEK, a 329% increase vs. the 3.5-complaint weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 5.58), suggesting either new illegal conversions or sudden enforcement activity.
evidence: 15 building/use complaints THIS WEEK vs. 3.5 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (329% spike)
Z-score of 5.58 indicates statistically significant deviation
314 total DOB permits filed in last 90 days (172 alterations) suggests ongoing development activity that may not be compliant
reporting_angles: Cross-reference 311 complaint locations with DOB permits filed to identify patterns of unpermitted work or conversions
Interview HPD/DOB about whether they have launched a new enforcement sweep in Morris Park/Pelham Parkway

themes_detail.label: Water System Failures
themes_detail.summary: Water system complaints surged to 72 THREE WEEKS AGO, a 350% increase vs. the 16.0-complaint weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 5.36), indicating potential distribution infrastructure problems or widespread plumbing emergencies.
evidence: 72 water system complaints 3 weeks ago vs. 16.0 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (350% spike)
Spike occurred 3 weeks ago; unclear if issue has resolved or persists—warrants current status check
reporting_angles: Contact DEP to determine if there was a main break, pressure loss, or contamination event 3 weeks ago in Morris Park/Pelham Parkway
Interview affected residents about duration of outages and whether issue has persisted or recurred

themes_detail.label: Appliance-Related Emergencies
themes_detail.summary: Appliance complaints peaked at 23 THREE WEEKS AGO, a 202% increase vs. the 7.6-complaint weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 6.16), potentially signaling unsafe conditions in rental units or defective heating/cooling systems.
evidence: 23 appliance complaints 3 weeks ago vs. 7.6 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (202% spike)
Z-score of 6.16 indicates significant statistical outlier
Timing coincides with spring heating season transition—potential for failed HVAC/furnace systems
reporting_angles: Obtain HPD heat/hot water complaint data alongside appliance complaints to determine if spike reflects failed heating systems in rent-stabilized buildings
Interview tenants advocacy groups about whether there were coordinated complaints from specific buildings
